description: Edsel Ford established the Ford Foundation in 1936 with a $25,000 gift for scientific, educational and charitable purposes. Bequests from Edsel and Henry Ford made it the world's largest philanthropy by the mid-1940s, and the 1949 Gaither committee recast it as an international institution advancing human welfare, democracy, peace and opportunity. Today it is independent of the Ford family and company, stewarding a roughly $16 billion endowment and making about $500 million of grants annually.
